description:
Read parent zaq-h2i.3 current coding-agent handoff and its mandatory reuse map first; it supersedes historical comments. Follow AGENTS.md and referenced workflow, tool, reuse, code-quality, service and testing policies; DESIGN.md/BO guide for UI. Planning only: wait for explicit implementation authorization. New existing-test behavior changes need approval. Keep per-issue steps/evidence here. Action reuse: extend existing authorized domain operations and components; no new Action/endpoint/tool.

After channel/SMTP/widget implementation, inspect whole final diff for drift against parent reuse map. Prove the same selected adapter declarations flow through existing Bridge/CommunicationBridge normalization into BO, FileSettings validation and TransportRequirements.resolve; provider branches, duplicate normalization, validation and requirement builders are unacceptable. Extend existing contract/unit/property/Engine/LiveView suites for all three bridges, exact MB/ceilings, blank/whitespace/false, unsupported SMTP, proposed-config updates, failed lookups/recovery, hidden tabs and atomic rollback. Run focused isolated tests and mix q under docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; record actual evidence, not old logs. Update existing Channels/Engine owner docs and existing component Storybook stories; no parallel spec docs. Complete code review and present concrete screens for UX approval; do not author new feature browser journeys before that gate. This is integration validation/review, not numerical coverage/final precommit.
title: [zaq-h2i.3.12] Validate shared capability contracts and BO integration
